QuestInfo.0: I'll need to talk to Agent #b#p1103001##k of #m100000000#, who apparently received some disturbing news.
QuestInfo.1:
Was I too late in finding that black shadow? Apparently, the #o1210100#s at the #o1210100# Farm have caused a revolt. The agent believes that one of Black Mage's men has probably set up a device in the area that causes such chaos. #p1103001# assigned me to defeat the #r#o1210100#s#k and if I happen to come across an item called #b#t4032130##k, then I should bring it back to him. I can find the #r#o1210100#s#k in #m120020100#.

QuestInfo.2: I was able to eliminate #o1210100#s and prevented their revolt from being carried out any further. After handing in the #p1103001# to #t4032130#, he had a disturbed look on his face. I wonder what's going on.

0.0: Oh no, we're in deep trouble! #o1210100#s in #m100020100# have revolted! I have a feeling that's because we spotted the black shadows too late. Ahhh, we should have done something about it when we found a shadow at the Pig Farm. We must prevent the #o1210100#s from taking this any further!

yes.0: Please go battle #o1210100#s and #o1210101#s to prevent those #o1210100#s from causing more trouble. If you can defeat #r30 #o1210100#s#k and #r15 #o1210101#s#k, they'll know what they're up against and stop. Oh, while you're hunting #o1210100#, if you ever come across an item called #b#t4032130##k, please pick it up and give it to me! I'm not totally sure, but I think I have a general idea of what that item is...

no.0: Ahhh, we are running out of time! Once the #o1210100#s start revolting, you'll no longer be able to enjoy pork. Is that okay with you?

1.0: Wow, you were able to snuff out #o1210100#s' revolt! That was awesome! I think it's safe to say you are the #b#o1210100#s' worst nightmare#k, no? Okay... maybe not.
1.1: ...Hmmm, and that is... #t4032130#? I couldn't confirm its accuracy, so I wasn't sure if you'd bring it to me, but since you did... maybe that was the correct information...

yes.0: ...Maybe this all came about because of this doll...
